title: Yellowed Mellow Filipino Vegetable Pinakbet
description: A malty, aerated, crowd-pleaser Filipino dish featuring applesauce and confit-tomato, served in a scallop shell.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the chopped bitter melon, okra, eggplant, and string beans.
In a small bowl, whisk together the fish sauce, vegetable oil, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the fish sauce mixture over the vegetable mixture and toss to coat.
Spoon the vegetable mixture into scallop shells, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Top each scallop shell with a spoonful of applesauce and a spoonful of confit-tomato.
Bake the pinakbet in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Remove the pinakbet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the pinakbet hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
